requirements.title: Evidence-bound presentation families
requirements.implementation: Accepted reader mappings take precedence; provider-linked families additionally require the exact accepted Arabic target hash and current source quotation bindings. Each occurrence, language, edition, source/version and relation remains accessible; full identities prevent short-ID collisions.
tests: tests/test_bank_discovery.py: provider_families_require_identity_and_exact_arabic; counterpart_grouping_requires_exact_current_source_binding; ambiguous_raw_ids_cannot_form_provider_families

tests/test_reader_grouping.py; tests/test_lazy_store.js: accepted mappings, variant scope and exact full-identity detail binding
scripts/verify_discovery_browser.py: reference_number_collision_evidence_family_and_multilingual_preference; workspace source versions/comparison evidence
remaining: Fresh final-corpus portable report must recompute all families and preserve every full source object.
Read actual source-bound family and presentation-result totals from the final build, then verify representative grouping on the deployed revision.
limitations: Grouping is presentation only, not an exhaustive unique-hadith audit or a new scholarly identity review.
No title/number/text-similarity merging; related, uncertain or unsupported identities stay separate. Accepted excerpt/parallel qualifications remain visible.

requirements.title: Compact ranked search and bounded lazy delivery
requirements.implementation: A multilingual positional index loads compact navigation, query-specific postings and visible-page previews; full narration objects load selectively. Verified parts, cancellation, cache bounds, retry/error/offline states and lossless staging reuse preserve correctness.
tests: tests/test_discovery_engine.js: selective parts, warm cache, cancellation, corrupt source bindings, cache eviction, missing previews
tests/test_lazy_store.js: exact detail spans, cache/concurrency/cancellation/corruption/export
tests/test_refresh_reader_reuse.py: HTML/source/site/data-prefix bindings and every copied part; standalone branch retained
scripts/benchmark_discovery_browser.py and browser transport-failure checks
remaining: Fresh full-corpus build and unchanged 950 MB staged-site budget gate.
Completed matched-host baseline/candidate cold and warm browser measurements including startup/CDP bytes; candidate_complete must be true.
Post-deploy live cold/warm measurements on the expected HTML and source revision.
limitations: The prior 108,502-row streaming artifact measurements are pre-final-caption local diagnostics, not final bytes or network latency.
Navigation still has a measurable startup cost; no universal speedup claim before measurements.
Unrequested hosted detail is not automatically available offline. Recorded cache/error/retry behavior does not imply whole-corpus offline installation.
Explicit commentary/source-context search retains the existing progressive source scan and is labelled slower; compact primary-narration benchmarks do not measure that opt-in path.

requirements.title: Reference, wording and editorial-topic journeys
requirements.implementation: Canonical references remain separate from source-local/provider numbers. Positional phrases, safe multilingual search keys, bounded transliteration/synonym aids and explicit spelling suggestions operate without rewriting quotations. Broader wording is an explained fallback only after strict unquoted wording fails, with missing terms and required negation retained.
tests: tests/test_bank_discovery.py: canonical/local/provider numbering and multiscript normalization
tests/test_discovery_engine.js: exact references, phrases, Arabic/CJK/Indic queries, late text, no results, transparent suggestions and negation-preserving fallback
scripts/verify_discovery_browser.py: default reference, numbering collisions, phrase/Arabic/no-results, topic/spelling and broader-wording checks
remaining: Complete final-corpus representative queries and matching-source assertions, with actual counts derived from its snapshot.
Live benchmark covers Bukhari 1, actions depend on intentions, anger and controlling anger; live smoke also checks remembered-wording transparency.
limitations: Editorial topics and suggestions are retrieval aids, not source-authored classifications or religious rulings.
Broader wording is partial keyword retrieval, not semantic equivalence; quoted/ID/reference searches remain strict.
Curated transliteration/synonyms and character tokenization are not comprehensive linguistic search or proof of exhaustive recall.

requirements.title: Compact preferred-language results and source workspace
requirements.implementation: Preferred stored-language previews, collection/reference/source/review metadata lead to an on-demand Arabic/English/selected-language workspace. Actual matching wording remains bound to its own occurrence/language even when the preferred preview differs. Stored, external, pending/mismatched and missing readings stay distinct; full provenance, qualified links, history, exports and reading controls remain.
tests: tests/test_language_readings.py: own citations/bytes, pending scope, explicit versions, numbering, duplicate-ID links and history
tests/test_discovery_engine.js: family preference versus matched occurrence, exact Unicode excerpts and availability
tests/test_lazy_store.js: selected export retains exact original objects
scripts/verify_discovery_browser.py: workspace/evidence/RTL, matching passage attribution, ambiguous links, offline detail recovery and keyboard focus
remaining: Final-corpus desktop/production browser reports and source-bound export/detail checks.
Deployed mobile workspace/keyboard/back navigation and representative direct-link/source-link review; do not infer every desktop fixture assertion ran live.
limitations: An initial source preview is labelled separately when it does not contain the match; exact matching text may require one selective detail request.
Missing translations are not generated; external links are not stored quotations.
Automated DOM/ARIA/accessibility-tree checks are not a human screenreader session or exhaustive device testing.

requirements.title: Evidence-backed navigation and facets
requirements.implementation: Collection and source-supplied heading paths expose source book/section and dependent chapter/subsection navigation. Narrator, report type and named-authority grades appear only from supplied metadata; unknown remains unknown. Namespaced source categories and explicitly editorial topics remain separate.
tests: tests/test_bank_discovery.py: own source metadata, unknown grader, explicit hierarchy, category namespace and no invented title-as-book
tests/test_discovery_engine.js: source facets together and actual empty-Reference hierarchy fixture
tests/test_discovery_binding.py: fabricated availability/grades/facets/locators rejected
scripts/verify_discovery_browser.py: evidenced_collection_parent_chapter_source_category_narrator_type_and_named_authority_grade_facets
remaining: Fresh full-corpus source-derived metadata/facet validation and final production navigation checks.
For final examples, cite the actual supplied authority and report type; do not infer absent metadata from collection identity.
limitations: Coverage follows preserved metadata; not every record supplies narrator, chapter, type or a named grading authority.
Generic hadith/source-fragment types do not automatically become Prophetic reports.
Where exact hierarchy roles are not supplied, generic source-section labels are used; grading display is attribution, not an independent authenticity judgment.

requirements.title: Friendly, source-bound edition identities
requirements.implementation: Accepted material title, explicit translator and supplied nontechnical publication edition form captions. Parts group only through identical source bytes with required bindings, documented pinned-provider identity, or explicit accepted storage-partition metadata. Same captions are disambiguated while original source IDs, paths, hashes and editions remain provenance.
tests: tests/test_bank_discovery.py: unrelated same labels stay separate; partition proof required; manifest source bindings; accepted title precedence; genuine volume/edition retained
tests/test_reader_grouping.py: duplicate collection labels retain distinct keys
tests/test_language_readings.py: full identity links and source-owned translator credit
scripts/verify_discovery_browser.py: technical-chunk edition facet and distinct friendly captions/full qualified-ID assertions; caption_fixture correction
remaining: Fresh final-corpus manifest/edition metadata validation and accurate final counts.
Inspect representative technical parts, genuine volumes and duplicate friendly labels on the final published revision.
limitations: A label is not evidence of a shared edition; no grouping by title, number or suffix alone.
Source edition N is a presentation disambiguator, not an invented publisher edition number.
Missing translator/publication metadata remains missing; PDF package recognition grants no edition-equivalence inference.

covers: Expected staged HTML SHA-256 and source build commit over public HTTPS with bounded 120-second stale-publication retry.
Core discovery index compressed/decoded length+SHA, schema, count, source-stream binding and recomputed ordered ID sequence.
Browser navigation independently matches expected HTML/source revision.
Production mobile home/results/workspace overflow, default Bukhari 1 recognition, Arabic reading, keyboard focus/back navigation and browser accessibility tree.
Production remembered wording returns source results with consistent broader-wording notice when used.
Separate desktop benchmark completes cold and warm searches for Bukhari 1, actions depend on intentions, anger, controlling anger, with startup/CDP bytes and expected HTML/source binding per query.
does_not_claim: It does not independently redownload and compare every raw corpus object or every unrequested posting/preview/detail part from live Pages. That preservation gate belongs to the validated build; requested browser parts are hash verified by the runtime.
It does not rerun every controlled fixture ambiguity/facet/export/offline/corruption scenario against public production.
It does not follow and validate every external source URL or certify translations, religious authenticity or accessibility for every assistive technology.
A completion benchmark gate has no universal numeric latency/speedup threshold; measured results must still be reported and assessed.
